violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS AND RAW SHRIMP STORED OVER PREPARED VEGETABLES AND SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: PORTIONED SALAD AT 70F ON PREP COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CHICKEN BROTH AND IN HOUSE TERIYAKI SAUCE PREPARED TWO DAY PRIOR IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, VINEGAR, WATER NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter and hanging on hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED TO SANITIZER BUCKETS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE WET WIPING CLOTHS ARE RETURNED TO SANITIZER BUCKETS WHEN NOT IN USE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink: AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASH SINK ONLY. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:COOKED PORK AT 44F, CORN AT 54F AND BOILED EGG AT 47F IN ICE BATH .
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TIME FOR TCS FOODS IN ICE BATH AND DISCARD UNUSED OR UNSOLD FOODS AT 2:30 PM. EHS WILL FORWARD TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: SUSHI RICE IN WARMER WITHOUT 4 HOUR TIME MARKED OR LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED 4 HOUR LABEL DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS AND SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OILS, SAUCES, SALT, SPICES, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL CONTAINERS OF FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING ARE LABELED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. CONDIMENTS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN FRONT SERVICE AREA; FOODS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN WALK IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE DUNNAGE RACKS OR APPROVED SHELVING TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter: IN KITCHEN AND BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE SANITIZER BUCKETS SET UP WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO STORE WET WIPING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS were found stored DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS FOR STORAGE OF SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: RICE COOKERS, DOUGH MIXER, REFRIGERATORS, COUNTERS AND GRILL LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOUL ODOR EMANATING FROM GREASE TRAP CONNECTED TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REQUEST CLEANING SERVICE AND HAVE COMPLETED SERVICE REPORT AVAILABLE FOR REVIEW BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: RAW SALMON SERVED IN SUSHI & SASHIMI.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REQUEST PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM SUPPLIER AND EMAIL COPY TO EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS. Bento House (Inspection Date: 08/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: BOILED EGG IN SOY SAUCE AT 73F FOR MORE THAN 3 HOURS ON COUNTER IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE MONITOR FOODS IN COOLING AND USE PROPER COOLING METHODS TO ENSURE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SMOKED EEL AT 45F IN TRUE 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: BOILED EGG IN SOY SAUCE AT 73F FOR MORE THAN 3 HOURS ON COUNTER IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. violations.title: Equipment Cooking Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment were observed soiled with an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and/or other debris: EQUIPMENT SURFACES IN FRONT KITCHEN AND BACK KITCHEN AREAS WITH ACCUMULATION OF GREASE AND DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue and other debris to maintain a sanitary work environment and prevent pest attraction. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE IMPLEMENT AND MAINTAIN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: AT MOP SINK FAUCET WITH HOSE AND SPRAY NOZZLE ATTACHED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE HOSE WIH SPRAY NOZZLE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT RECONNECT HOSE AND SPRAY NOZZLE WITHOUT APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE IMPLEMENT AND MAINTAIN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: FROZEN SHRIMP IN CONTAINER OF WATER IN PREP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC OPENED FAUCET TO CONTINUE THAWING UNDER RUNNING WATER IN PREP SINK.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: SPOONS USED TO SERVE COOKED WHITE RICE AND FRIED RICE STORED IN CONTAINERS WITH ACCUMULATION OF DRIED FOOD PARTICLES AND AND GRIME.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE CONTAINERS TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED AND REPLACE SPOONS AND STORAGE CONTAINERS WITH CLEAN AND SANITIZED ONES.
